Step into a fairytale with the Ballet Slipper Corset! 🩰
(Made from the same fabric as the Green Fairy Corset.)
Crafted from glossy crystal satin with a soft, wet-look sheen, this corset glows like silk under the light. The delicate blush pink evokes the elegance of satin pointe shoes and the dreamy haze of a spring morning. Photos cannot capture its true charm—you have to see it sparkle in person!
Available in Libra and Slim Long.

Love the fabric but can't find it in your silhouette? Special order this fabric in the corset that fits your body. How To Special Order

Add a corset liner, modesty panel or alternative laces to your order and save: Accessories

The Libra astrology sign represents symmetry and balance. This corset was designed by Lucy's Corsetry as the answer for bodies that have similar measurements for both rib cage and hips. It provides a middle ground for those bodies that are shorter than a standard but longer than a waspie. For more information about the Libra Silhouette check out our page: Libra Silhouette

Corset pattern designed in collaboration with Lucy's Corsetry!

Sizing info:

Start by finding the corset size that corresponds to your natural waist measurement, then size up or down to get the best fit at the hips and underbust.

  • the corset should match your ribs and hip measurements as best as possible.
  • It is normal for the corset waist to be smaller than your natural waist.

We recommend a lacing gap of 1" to 3" for comfort and adjustability during the day. We do not recommend anything larger than a 3" lacing gap.

For information on how to measure yourself to get the best fit watch our video:

Prepare to enchant on Valentine's Day with the captivating allure of our Bed of Roses corset. Meticulously crafted from luxurious 100% cotton and adorned with matching lacing, the "Bed of Roses" corset ensures both comfort and refinement. Ideal for infusing a romantic touch into any special occasion, this corset, featuring charming lacing and structured boning, beautifully enhances your curves while ensuring a perfect fit through its adjustable lacing. 

Love the fabric but can't find it in your silhouette? Special order this fabric in the corset that fits your body. How To Special Order

Add an accessory to your order and save: Accessories

Even curvier than the Hourglass cut, the Gemini cut is designed for those with naturally curvy figures or experienced corset wearers. Comes with 6 garter tabs.


Your hips must be at least 10 inches greater than your waist to fit the Gemini Corset.

 

Sizing info:

(If you need help, we have agents in 3 different time zones ready to help you! Reach out to support@timeless-trends.com )

Start by finding the corset size that corresponds to your natural waist measurement, then size up or down to get the best fit at the hips and underbust.

  • the corset should match your ribs and hip measurements as best as possible.
  • It is normal for the corset waist to be smaller than your natural waist.

We recommend a lacing gap of 1" to 3" for comfort and adjustability during the day. We do not recommend anything larger than a 3" lacing gap.

More about the Gemini Corset:

TWO SILHOUETTES TO CHOOSE FROM:

The Gemini corset is offered in two silhouettes: Conical rib and Round rib!

The Round rib version is designed to cup over the ribcage and place compression around the waist, while leaving room for the ribs. This is appropriate for those who have larger or inflexible ribs.

The Conical rib is cut straight from the underbust to waist, and will give you a tapered look with more compression on the floating ribs. This is recommended more for experienced corset wearers and those with a naturally smaller or flexible ribcage.

Both silhouettes are identical from the waist to hips; only the ribcage is affected.

CURVE:

The Gemini corset is designed for experienced corset wearers or those with naturally curvy figures. It is one step curvier than the hourglass corset: where the hourglass has a 6.5" rib spring, the Gemini will have an 8" rib spring. Where the hourglass has a 10" high hip spring, the Gemini has a 14" high hip spring. A customer who can fit the hourglass corset in size 26" should be able to comfortably fit the Gemini in size 24".

 

A LONGLINE LOOK - WITHOUT THE LENGTH:

The Gemini has the look of a longline corset, so it extends down over the hips on the side and accommodates a 16" low hip spring. The longline corset is aesthetically preferred among some corset wearers. The extra smoothing and support over the hip area provides a beautiful silhouette, and in many cases the corset snuggles better under the waistband of slacks and skirts compared to corsets cut high over the hips. However, you don't have to be long-waisted to wear the Gemini, because it's same length as the regular hourglass in the front and along the princess seam! It will fit anyone with a waist length of 9 inches or more. It will fit like a comfortable longline corset for a petite or short-waisted person.

 

EXTRA BONES FOR SUPPORT:

For sizes 22 and larger, the Gemini corset has extra spiral steel bones in the center of some panels to provide extra vertical tension to the corset, preventing wrinkling or buckling of the fabric and ensuring it stays smooth on the body. The spiral steels are still the high quality, flexible, comfortable bones you've come to know from Timeless Trends.

 

HIGHER BACK TO HOLD THE "MUFFIN":

You spoke and we listened! The Gemini corset has a slightly higher back compared to the hourglass corsets, to help hold in the "muffin top" or skin roll-over.

Our beige 100% cotton corset is the perfect corset for stealthing.  Made with two layers of cotton twill, laminated for strength to a soft 100% cotton outer layer. Even curvier than the Hourglass cut, the Gemini cut is designed for those with naturally curvy figures or experienced corset wearers. Comes with 6 garter tabs. Garter straps sold separately.


Your hips must be at least 10 inches greater than your waist to fit the Gemini Corset.

The Gemini Long is perfect for pear-shaped individuals who have a naturally narrow ribcage, who are high waisted, and who have a more gradual and sloping hip spring (one does not need a "high, square hip-shelf" in order to wear the Gemini Long!)

Careful patterning and rigorous testing has been performed on the Gemini Long in order to ensure that the lower abdomen is pulled in and supported without significant bowing or exaggeration of any "tummy pooch". This is perfect for those who have experienced pregnancy or significant weight loss and are looking to flatten their lower tummy apron.

Where the Hourglass Long is for "low waisted" individuals (longer from the waist up and a little shorter from the waist down, to allow wearers with a shallow pelvis to sit down easily without the bottom edge of the corset hitting their lap), the Gemini Long is the opposite, designed for "higher waisted" bodies (longer from the waist down and shorter from the waist up, so that the lower tummy is fully covered, while not pushing up on the bustline unnaturally).

Where the Hourglass Long has side hip ties, the Gemini is closed on the hip, so those who are looking for a stealthy appearance under clothing will appreciate its smoothness, and those who have sensitive hips don't have to worry about any ribbon leaving imprints over the hip bones.

More about the Gemini Corset:

TWO SILHOUETTES TO CHOOSE FROM:

The Gemini corset is offered in two silhouettes: Conical rib and Round rib!

The Round rib version is designed to cup over the ribcage and place compression around the waist, while leaving room for the ribs. This is appropriate for those who have larger or inflexible ribs.

The Conical rib is cut straight from the underbust to waist, and will give you a tapered look with more compression on the floating ribs. This is recommended more for experienced corset wearers and those with a naturally smaller or flexible ribcage.

Both silhouettes are identical from the waist to hips; only the ribcage is affected.

CURVE:

The Gemini corset is designed for experienced corset wearers or those with naturally curvy figures. It is one step curvier than the hourglass corset: where the hourglass has a 6.5" rib spring, the Gemini will have an 8" rib spring. Where the hourglass has a 10" high hip spring, the Gemini has a 14" high hip spring. A customer who can fit the hourglass corset in size 26" should be able to comfortably fit the Gemini in size 24".

 

A LONGLINE LOOK - WITHOUT THE LENGTH:

The Gemini has the look of a longline corset, so it extends down over the hips on the side and accommodates a 16" low hip spring. The longline corset is aesthetically preferred among some corset wearers. The extra smoothing and support over the hip area provides a beautiful silhouette, and in many cases the corset snuggles better under the waistband of slacks and skirts compared to corsets cut high over the hips. However, you don't have to be long-waisted to wear the Gemini, because it's same length as the regular hourglass in the front and along the princess seam! It will fit anyone with a waist length of 9 inches or more. It will fit like a comfortable longline corset for a petite or short-waisted person.

 

EXTRA BONES FOR SUPPORT:

For sizes 22 and larger, the Gemini corset has extra spiral steel bones in the center of some panels to provide extra vertical tension to the corset, preventing wrinkling or buckling of the fabric and ensuring it stays smooth on the body. The spiral steels are still the high quality, flexible, comfortable bones you've come to know from Timeless Trends.

 

HIGHER BACK TO HOLD THE "MUFFIN":

You spoke and we listened! The Gemini corset has a slightly higher back compared to the hourglass corsets, to help hold in the "muffin top" or skin roll-over.

Our beige 100% cotton corset is the perfect corset for stealthing.  Made with two layers of cotton twill, laminated for strength to a soft 100% cotton outer layer. Even curvier than the Hourglass cut, the Gemini cut is designed for those with naturally curvy figures or experienced corset wearers. Comes with 6 garter tabs. Garter straps sold separately.


Your hips must be at least 10 inches greater than your waist to fit the Gemini Corset.

The Gemini Long is perfect for pear-shaped individuals who have a naturally narrow ribcage, who are high waisted, and who have a more gradual and sloping hip spring (one does not need a "high, square hip-shelf" in order to wear the Gemini Long!)

Careful patterning and rigorous testing has been performed on the Gemini Long in order to ensure that the lower abdomen is pulled in and supported without significant bowing or exaggeration of any "tummy pooch". This is perfect for those who have experienced pregnancy or significant weight loss and are looking to flatten their lower tummy apron.

Where the Hourglass Long is for "low waisted" individuals (longer from the waist up and a little shorter from the waist down, to allow wearers with a shallow pelvis to sit down easily without the bottom edge of the corset hitting their lap), the Gemini Long is the opposite, designed for "higher waisted" bodies (longer from the waist down and shorter from the waist up, so that the lower tummy is fully covered, while not pushing up on the bustline unnaturally).

Where the Hourglass Long has side hip ties, the Gemini is closed on the hip, so those who are looking for a stealthy appearance under clothing will appreciate its smoothness, and those who have sensitive hips don't have to worry about any ribbon leaving imprints over the hip bones.

(If you need help, we have agents in 3 different time zones ready to help you! Reach out to support@timeless-trends.com )

  • the corset should match your ribs and hip measurements as best as possible.
  • It is normal for the corset waist to be smaller than your natural waist.

More about the Gemini Corset:

TWO SILHOUETTES TO CHOOSE FROM:

The Gemini corset is offered in two silhouettes: Conical rib and Round rib!

The Round rib version is designed to cup over the ribcage and place compression around the waist, while leaving room for the ribs. This is appropriate for those who have larger or inflexible ribs.

The Conical rib is cut straight from the underbust to waist, and will give you a tapered look with more compression on the floating ribs. This is recommended more for experienced corset wearers and those with a naturally smaller or flexible ribcage.

Both silhouettes are identical from the waist to hips; only the ribcage is affected.

CURVE:

The Gemini corset is designed for experienced corset wearers or those with naturally curvy figures. It is one step curvier than the hourglass corset: where the hourglass has a 6.5" rib spring, the Gemini will have an 8" rib spring. Where the hourglass has a 10" high hip spring, the Gemini has a 14" high hip spring. A customer who can fit the hourglass corset in size 26" should be able to comfortably fit the Gemini in size 24".

 

A LONGLINE LOOK - WITHOUT THE LENGTH:

The Gemini has the look of a longline corset, so it extends down over the hips on the side and accommodates a 16" low hip spring. The longline corset is aesthetically preferred among some corset wearers. The extra smoothing and support over the hip area provides a beautiful silhouette, and in many cases the corset snuggles better under the waistband of slacks and skirts compared to corsets cut high over the hips. However, you don't have to be long-waisted to wear the Gemini, because it's same length as the regular hourglass in the front and along the princess seam! It will fit anyone with a waist length of 9 inches or more. It will fit like a comfortable longline corset for a petite or short-waisted person.

 

EXTRA BONES FOR SUPPORT:

For sizes 22 and larger, the Gemini corset has extra spiral steel bones in the center of some panels to provide extra vertical tension to the corset, preventing wrinkling or buckling of the fabric and ensuring it stays smooth on the body. The spiral steels are still the high quality, flexible, comfortable bones you've come to know from Timeless Trends.

 

HIGHER BACK TO HOLD THE "MUFFIN":

You spoke and we listened! The Gemini corset has a slightly higher back compared to the hourglass corsets, to help hold in the "muffin top" or skin roll-over.

TWO SILHOUETTES TO CHOOSE FROM:

The Gemini corset is offered in two silhouettes: Conical rib and Round rib!

The Round rib version is designed to cup over the ribcage and place compression around the waist, while leaving room for the ribs. This is appropriate for those who have larger or inflexible ribs.

The Conical rib is cut straight from the underbust to waist, and will give you a tapered look with more compression on the floating ribs. This is recommended more for experienced corset wearers and those with a naturally smaller or flexible ribcage.

Both silhouettes are identical from the waist to hips; only the ribcage is affected.

CURVE:

Where the hourglass has a 10" high hip spring, the Gemini has a 14" high hip spring. A customer who can fit the hourglass corset in size 26" should be able to comfortably fit the Gemini in size 24".

 

A LONGLINE LOOK - WITHOUT THE LENGTH:

The Gemini has the look of a longline corset, so it extends down over the hips on the side and accommodates a 16" low hip spring. The extra smoothing and support over the hip area provides a beautiful silhouette, and in many cases the corset snuggles better under the waistband of slacks and skirts compared to corsets cut high over the hips. For sizes 22 and larger, the Gemini corset has extra spiral steel bones in the center of some panels to provide extra vertical tension to the corset, preventing wrinkling or buckling of the fabric and ensuring it stays smooth on the body. The spiral steels are still the high quality, flexible, comfortable bones you've come to know from Timeless Trends.

You spoke and we listened! The Gemini corset has a slightly higher back compared to the hourglass corsets, to help hold in the "muffin top" or skin roll-over.

* Why do we insist on a lacing gap for our overbusts?
A lacing gap makes sure that the "dip" at the side seam will align with your armpit. Imagine the bottom of the armscye where a sleeve is placed in a shirt. You don't want the arm hole to be too forward or too back!
Our hourglass overbusts also have a high back to help smooth any "muffin" and this part should rest over your shoulder blades. If they are too far back they can lead to more rolls, not less! So a gap is recommended. All of our overbust corsets come with a free laced-in modesty panel to protect your back and look great.

✨ Timeless Trends continues its partnership with Lucy Corsetry! 👗💫

After hearing lots of feedback about the Underbust Hourglass Regular (UHR), Lucy designed the UFR: Underbust, Funnel, Regular. The UFR keeps the same length, rib, and hip spring as our Hourglass Regular, but with a few thoughtful tweaks:

  • Straight (funnel) rib: The biggest difference—gives a tapered, sleek look.
  • Smoother lower tummy: Less pointed at the center front, making it sit better under clothing.
  • Squared upper back: Reduces “muffin top” around the shoulder blades.
  • Adjusted waistline: UFR is 5" from waist to underbust and 5" from waist to lower edge (compared to 5.5" and 4.5" on UHR), so shorter above the waist and slightly longer below.
  • Enhanced waist-to-hip curve: A slightly more convex shape and a bit longer on the hip for added comfort, especially for those with sensitive hip bones.

🖤 Currently available in Black Cotton, Beige Cotton, Black Fine Mesh No Line, and Beige Fine Mesh No Line fabrics.

More about the Gemini Corset:

TWO SILHOUETTES TO CHOOSE FROM:

The Gemini corset is offered in two silhouettes: Conical rib and Round rib!

The Round rib version is designed to cup over the ribcage and place compression around the waist, while leaving room for the ribs. This is appropriate for those who have larger or inflexible ribs.

The Conical rib is cut straight from the underbust to waist, and will give you a tapered look with more compression on the floating ribs. This is recommended more for experienced corset wearers and those with a naturally smaller or flexible ribcage.

Both silhouettes are identical from the waist to hips; only the ribcage is affected.

CURVE:

The Gemini corset is designed for experienced corset wearers or those with naturally curvy figures. It is one step curvier than the hourglass corset: where the hourglass has a 6.5" rib spring, the Gemini will have an 8" rib spring. Where the hourglass has a 10" high hip spring, the Gemini has a 14" high hip spring. A customer who can fit the hourglass corset in size 26" should be able to comfortably fit the Gemini in size 24".

 

A LONGLINE LOOK - WITHOUT THE LENGTH:

The Gemini has the look of a longline corset, so it extends down over the hips on the side and accommodates a 16" low hip spring. The longline corset is aesthetically preferred among some corset wearers. Our most popular fabric by far, the black cashmere fashion fabric featured here in our fabulous Gemini Silhouette is an excellent choice for shape wear, casual, classic, or more ensembles. Even curvier than the Hourglass cut, the Gemini cut is designed for those with naturally curvy figures or experienced corset wearers. Comes with 6 garter tabs. Garter straps sold separately.


Your hips must be at least 10 inches greater than your waist to fit the Gemini Corset.

The Gemini Long is perfect for pear-shaped individuals who have a naturally narrow ribcage, who are high waisted, and who have a more gradual and sloping hip spring (one does not need a "high, square hip-shelf" in order to wear the Gemini Long!)

Careful patterning and rigorous testing has been performed on the Gemini Long in order to ensure that the lower abdomen is pulled in and supported without significant bowing or exaggeration of any "tummy pooch". This is perfect for those who have experienced pregnancy or significant weight loss and are looking to flatten their lower tummy apron.

Where the Hourglass Long is for "low waisted" individuals (longer from the waist up and a little shorter from the waist down, to allow wearers with a shallow pelvis to sit down easily without the bottom edge of the corset hitting their lap), the Gemini Long is the opposite, designed for "higher waisted" bodies (longer from the waist down and shorter from the waist up, so that the lower tummy is fully covered, while not pushing up on the bustline unnaturally).

Where the Hourglass Long has side hip ties, the Gemini is closed on the hip, so those who are looking for a stealthy appearance under clothing will appreciate its smoothness, and those who have sensitive hips don't have to worry about any ribbon leaving imprints over the hip bones.

The Gemini corset is offered in two silhouettes: Conical rib and Round rib!

The Round rib version is designed to cup over the ribcage and place compression around the waist, while leaving room for the ribs. This is appropriate for those who have larger or inflexible ribs.

The Conical rib is cut straight from the underbust to waist, and will give you a tapered look with more compression on the floating ribs. This is recommended more for experienced corset wearers and those with a naturally smaller or flexible ribcage.

Both silhouettes are identical from the waist to hips; only the ribcage is affected.

CURVE:

The Gemini corset is designed for experienced corset wearers or those with naturally curvy figures. It is one step curvier than the hourglass corset: where the hourglass has a 6.5" rib spring, the Gemini will have an 8" rib spring. Where the hourglass has a 10" high hip spring, the Gemini has a 14" high hip spring. A customer who can fit the hourglass corset in size 26" should be able to comfortably fit the Gemini in size 24".

Our most popular fabric by far, the black cashmere fashion fabric featured here in our fabulous Gemini Silhouette is an excellent choice for shape wear, casual, classic, or more ensembles. Even curvier than the Hourglass cut, the Gemini cut is designed for those with naturally curvy figures or experienced corset wearers. Comes with 6 garter tabs. Garter straps sold separately.


Your hips must be at least 10 inches greater than your waist to fit the Gemini Corset.

The Gemini Long is perfect for pear-shaped individuals who have a naturally narrow ribcage, who are high waisted, and who have a more gradual and sloping hip spring (one does not need a "high, square hip-shelf" in order to wear the Gemini Long!)

Careful patterning and rigorous testing has been performed on the Gemini Long in order to ensure that the lower abdomen is pulled in and supported without significant bowing or exaggeration of any "tummy pooch". This is perfect for those who have experienced pregnancy or significant weight loss and are looking to flatten their lower tummy apron.

Where the Hourglass Long is for "low waisted" individuals (longer from the waist up and a little shorter from the waist down, to allow wearers with a shallow pelvis to sit down easily without the bottom edge of the corset hitting their lap), the Gemini Long is the opposite, designed for "higher waisted" bodies (longer from the waist down and shorter from the waist up, so that the lower tummy is fully covered, while not pushing up on the bustline unnaturally).

Where the Hourglass Long has side hip ties, the Gemini is closed on the hip, so those who are looking for a stealthy appearance under clothing will appreciate its smoothness, and those who have sensitive hips don't have to worry about any ribbon leaving imprints over the hip bones.


Sizing info:

(If you need help, we have agents in 3 different time zones ready to help you! Reach out to support@timeless-trends.com )

  • the corset should match your ribs and hip measurements as best as possible.
  • It is normal for the corset waist to be smaller than your natural waist.

We recommend a lacing gap of 1" to 3" for comfort and adjustability during the day. We do not recommend anything larger than a 3" lacing gap.

More about the Gemini Corset:

TWO SILHOUETTES TO CHOOSE FROM:

The Gemini corset is offered in two silhouettes: Conical rib and Round rib!

The Round rib version is designed to cup over the ribcage and place compression around the waist, while leaving room for the ribs. This is appropriate for those who have larger or inflexible ribs.

The Conical rib is cut straight from the underbust to waist, and will give you a tapered look with more compression on the floating ribs. This is recommended more for experienced corset wearers and those with a naturally smaller or flexible ribcage.

Both silhouettes are identical from the waist to hips; only the ribcage is affected.

CURVE:

The Gemini corset is designed for experienced corset wearers or those with naturally curvy figures. It is one step curvier than the hourglass corset: where the hourglass has a 6.5" rib spring, the Gemini will have an 8" rib spring. Where the hourglass has a 10" high hip spring, the Gemini has a 14" high hip spring. A customer who can fit the hourglass corset in size 26" should be able to comfortably fit the Gemini in size 24".

 

A LONGLINE LOOK - WITHOUT THE LENGTH:

The Gemini has the look of a longline corset, so it extends down over the hips on the side and accommodates a 16" low hip spring. The longline corset is aesthetically preferred among some corset wearers. The extra smoothing and support over the hip area provides a beautiful silhouette, and in many cases the corset snuggles better under the waistband of slacks and skirts compared to corsets cut high over the hips. However, you don't have to be long-waisted to wear the Gemini, because it's same length as the regular hourglass in the front and along the princess seam! It will fit anyone with a waist length of 9 inches or more. It will fit like a comfortable longline corset for a petite or short-waisted person.

 

EXTRA BONES FOR SUPPORT:

For sizes 22 and larger, the Gemini corset has extra spiral steel bones in the center of some panels to provide extra vertical tension to the corset, preventing wrinkling or buckling of the fabric and ensuring it stays smooth on the body. The spiral steels are still the high quality, flexible, comfortable bones you've come to know from Timeless Trends.

 

HIGHER BACK TO HOLD THE "MUFFIN":

You spoke and we listened! The Gemini corset has a slightly higher back compared to the hourglass corsets, to help hold in the "muffin top" or skin roll-over.

The Libra astrology sign represents symmetry and balance. This corset was designed by Lucy's Corsetry as the answer for bodies that have similar measurements for both rib cage and hips.

The Libby is identical to the Libra in every way except the waist reduction is less dramatic. In the years since the Libra was released, we noticed that there was a real need for a less extreme version. The Libby is a perfect "stepping stone" corset for those who want to waist train and eventually graduate to the original Libra. Ideal for "ruler" or "apple" shaped wearers, or muscular wearers who don't have a lot of squish.

Through clever design, the Libby still looks surprisingly curvy and does not give a "straight" figure. This is why we prefer to call it the Libra Gentle, or just "Libby", instead of the Libra Slim.

  • If you wear the original Libra with a small lacing gap: go up 1 size in the Libby
  • If you wear the original Libra laced closed: go up 2 sizes in the Libby

* Why do we insist on a lacing gap for our overbusts?
A lacing gap makes sure that the "dip" at the side seam will align with your armpit. Imagine the bottom of the armscye where a sleeve is placed in a shirt. You don't want the arm hole to be too forward or too back!
Our hourglass overbusts also have a high back to help smooth any "muffin" and this part should rest over your shoulder blades. If they are too far back they can lead to more rolls, not less! So a gap is recommended. All of our overbust corsets come with a free laced-in modesty panel to protect your back and look great.

About the Gemini Corset:

Your hips must be at least 10 inches greater than your waist to fit the Gemini Corset.

TWO SILHOUETTES TO CHOOSE FROM:

The Gemini corset is offered in two silhouettes: Conical (Straight) rib and Round (Cupped) rib!

The Round (Cupped) rib version is designed to cup over the ribcage and place compression around the waist, while leaving room for the ribs. This is appropriate for those who have larger or inflexible ribs.

The Conical (Straight) rib is cut straight from the underbust to waist, and will give you a tapered look with more compression on the floating ribs. This is recommended more for experienced corset wearers and those with a naturally smaller or flexible ribcage.

CURVE:

The Gemini corset is designed for experienced corset wearers or those with naturally curvy figures. It is one step curvier than the hourglass corset: where the hourglass has a 6.5" rib spring, the Gemini will have an 8" rib spring. Where the hourglass has a 10" high hip spring, the Gemini has a 14" high hip spring. A customer who can fit the hourglass corset in size 26" should be able to comfortably fit the Gemini in size 24".

A LONGLINE LOOK - WITHOUT THE LENGTH:

The Gemini has the look of a longline corset, so it extends down over the hips on the side and accommodates a 16" low hip spring. The longline corset is aesthetically preferred among some corset wearers. The extra smoothing and support over the hip area provides a beautiful silhouette, and in many cases the corset snuggles better under the waistband of slacks and skirts compared to corsets cut high over the hips. However, you don't have to be long-waisted to wear the Gemini, because it's same length as the regular hourglass in the front and along the princess seam! It will fit anyone with a waist length of 9 inches or more. It will fit like a comfortable longline corset for a petite or short-waisted person.

* Why do we insist on a lacing gap for our overbusts?
A lacing gap makes sure that the "dip" at the side seam will align with your armpit. Imagine the bottom of the armscye where a sleeve is placed in a shirt. You don't want the arm hole to be too forward or too back!
Our hourglass overbusts also have a high back to help smooth any "muffin" and this part should rest over your shoulder blades. If they are too far back they can lead to more rolls, not less! So a gap is recommended. All of our overbust corsets come with a free laced-in modesty panel to protect your back and look great.

More about the Gemini Corset:

TWO SILHOUETTES TO CHOOSE FROM:

The Gemini corset is offered in two silhouettes: Conical rib and Round rib!

The Round rib version is designed to cup over the ribcage and place compression around the waist, while leaving room for the ribs. This is appropriate for those who have larger or inflexible ribs.

The Conical rib is cut straight from the underbust to waist, and will give you a tapered look with more compression on the floating ribs. This is recommended more for experienced corset wearers and those with a naturally smaller or flexible ribcage.

Both silhouettes are identical from the waist to hips; only the ribcage is affected.

CURVE:

The Gemini corset is designed for experienced corset wearers or those with naturally curvy figures. It is one step curvier than the hourglass corset: where the hourglass has a 6.5" rib spring, the Gemini will have an 8" rib spring. Where the hourglass has a 10" high hip spring, the Gemini has a 14" high hip spring. A customer who can fit the hourglass corset in size 26" should be able to comfortably fit the Gemini in size 24".

 

A LONGLINE LOOK - WITHOUT THE LENGTH:

The Gemini has the look of a longline corset, so it extends down over the hips on the side and accommodates a 16" low hip spring. The longline corset is aesthetically preferred among some corset wearers. The extra smoothing and support over the hip area provides a beautiful silhouette, and in many cases the corset snuggles better under the waistband of slacks and skirts compared to corsets cut high over the hips. However, you don't have to be long-waisted to wear the Gemini, because it's same length as the regular hourglass in the front and along the princess seam! It will fit anyone with a waist length of 9 inches or more. It will fit like a comfortable longline corset for a petite or short-waisted person.

 

EXTRA BONES FOR SUPPORT:

For sizes 22 and larger, the Gemini corset has extra spiral steel bones in the center of some panels to provide extra vertical tension to the corset, preventing wrinkling or buckling of the fabric and ensuring it stays smooth on the body. The spiral steels are still the high quality, flexible, comfortable bones you've come to know from Timeless Trends.

 

HIGHER BACK TO HOLD THE "MUFFIN":

You spoke and we listened! The Gemini corset has a slightly higher back compared to the hourglass corsets, to help hold in the "muffin top" or skin roll-over.

SKU: UFR-003

✨ Timeless Trends continues its partnership with Lucy Corsetry! 👗💫

After hearing lots of feedback about the Underbust Hourglass Regular (UHR), Lucy designed the UFR: Underbust, Funnel, Regular. The UFR keeps the same length, rib, and hip spring as our Hourglass Regular, but with a few thoughtful tweaks:

  • Straight (funnel) rib: The biggest difference—gives a tapered, sleek look.
  • Smoother lower tummy: Less pointed at the center front, making it sit better under clothing.
  • Squared upper back: Reduces “muffin top” around the shoulder blades.
  • Adjusted waistline: UFR is 5" from waist to underbust and 5" from waist to lower edge (compared to 5.5" and 4.5" on UHR), so shorter above the waist and slightly longer below.
  • Enhanced waist-to-hip curve: A slightly more convex shape and a bit longer on the hip for added comfort, especially for those with sensitive hip bones.

🖤 Currently available in Black Cotton, Beige Cotton, Black Fine Mesh No Line, and Beige Fine Mesh No Line fabrics.

Bubble Blooms in Blue is a vibrant, floral-patterned corset that instantly catches the eye. Set against a lively blue background, the design features an array of flowers in shades of pink, orange, yellow, and purple. Subtle water droplet-like details add texture and depth to the fabric.

The corset boasts a structured silhouette that dramatically cinches the waist, enhancing natural curves. It includes a silver-tone metal busk closure at the front, while the top and bottom edges are finished with light blue binding for a clean, polished look.

The overall impression is cheerful and colorful — a bold, playful piece full of personality. Available in Gemini Straight and Libby. 

The Libra astrology sign represents symmetry and balance. This corset was designed by Lucy's Corsetry as the answer for bodies that have similar measurements for both rib cage and hips.

The Libby is identical to the Libra in every way except the waist reduction is less dramatic. In the years since the Libra was released, we noticed that there was a real need for a less extreme version. The Libby is a perfect "stepping stone" corset for those who want to waist train and eventually graduate to the original Libra. Ideal for "ruler" or "apple" shaped wearers, or muscular wearers who don't have a lot of squish.

Through clever design, the Libby still looks surprisingly curvy and does not give a "straight" figure. This is why we prefer to call it the Libra Gentle, or just "Libby", instead of the Libra Slim.

  • If you wear the original Libra with a small lacing gap: go up 1 size in the Libby
  • If you wear the original Libra laced closed: go up 2 sizes in the Libby

If you're unsure about your size, reach out to us at support@timeless-trends.com !

Its length is versatile; with a princess seam of 9 inches, it is shorter than a regular underbust corset but longer than a waspie. For more information about the Libra and Libby, check out our page: Libra Silhouette

Add an accessory to your order and save: Accessories

Even curvier than the Hourglass cut, the Gemini cut is designed for those with naturally curvy figures or experienced corset wearers. Comes with 6 garter tabs.


Your high hip must be at least 10 inches greater than your waist to fit the Gemini Corset.

The Conical (Straight) rib is cut straight from the underbust to waist, and will give you a tapered look with more compression on the floating ribs. This is recommended more for experienced corset wearers and those with a naturally smaller or flexible ribcage.


CURVE:

The Gemini corset is designed for experienced corset wearers or those with naturally curvy figures. It is one step curvier than the hourglass corset: where the hourglass has a 6.5" rib spring, the Gemini will have an 8" rib spring. Where the hourglass has a 10" high hip spring, the Gemini has a 14" high hip spring. A customer who can fit the hourglass corset in size 26" should be able to comfortably fit the Gemini in size 24".

A LONGLINE LOOK - WITHOUT THE LENGTH:

The Gemini has the look of a longline corset, so it extends down over the hips on the side and accommodates a 16" low hip spring. The longline corset is aesthetically preferred among some corset wearers. The extra smoothing and support over the hip area provides a beautiful silhouette, and in many cases the corset snuggles better under the waistband of slacks and skirts compared to corsets cut high over the hips. However, you don't have to be long-waisted to wear the Gemini, because it's same length as the regular hourglass in the front and along the princess seam! It will fit anyone with a waist length of 9 inches or more. It will fit like a comfortable longline corset for a petite or short-waisted person.

EXTRA BONES FOR SUPPORT:

For sizes 22 and larger, the Gemini corset has extra spiral steel bones in the center of some panels to provide extra vertical tension to the corset, preventing wrinkling or buckling of the fabric and ensuring it stays smooth on the body. The spiral steels are still the high quality, flexible, comfortable bones you've come to know from Timeless Trends.

burgundy-lace-and-black-mesh-straight-co.body_html:
SKU: GSL-711

Make a statement with the Burgundy Lace & Black Mesh Corset. Rich floral lace pairs with sheer black mesh for an elegant, eye-catching look, while premium steel boning provides superior shaping and support. Designed for comfort, confidence, and timeless style. Available in the Overbust Slim and Gemini Long silhouettes.


Your hips must be at least 10 inches greater than your waist to fit the Gemini Corset.

The Gemini Long is perfect for pear-shaped individuals who have a naturally narrow ribcage, who are high waisted, and who have a more gradual and sloping hip spring (one does not need a "high, square hip-shelf" in order to wear the Gemini Long!)

Careful patterning and rigorous testing has been performed on the Gemini Long in order to ensure that the lower abdomen is pulled in and supported without significant bowing or exaggeration of any "tummy pooch". This is perfect for those who have experienced pregnancy or significant weight loss and are looking to flatten their lower tummy apron.

Where the Hourglass Long is for "low waisted" individuals (longer from the waist up and a little shorter from the waist down, to allow wearers with a shallow pelvis to sit down easily without the bottom edge of the corset hitting their lap), the Gemini Long is the opposite, designed for "higher waisted" bodies (longer from the waist down and shorter from the waist up, so that the lower tummy is fully covered, while not pushing up on the bustline unnaturally).

Where the Hourglass Long has side hip ties, the Gemini is closed on the hip, so those who are looking for a stealthy appearance under clothing will appreciate its smoothness, and those who have sensitive hips don't have to worry about any ribbon leaving imprints over the hip bones.


Sizing info:

(If you need help, we have agents in 3 different time zones ready to help you! Reach out to support@timeless-trends.com )

Start by finding the corset size that corresponds to your natural waist measurement, then size up or down to get the best fit at the hips and underbust.

  • the corset should match your ribs and hip measurements as best as possible.
  • It is normal for the corset waist to be smaller than your natural waist.

We recommend a lacing gap of 1" to 3" for comfort and adjustability during the day. We do not recommend anything larger than a 3" lacing gap.

For information on how to measure yourself to get the best fit watch our video:

More about the Gemini Corset:

TWO SILHOUETTES TO CHOOSE FROM:

The Gemini corset is offered in two silhouettes: Conical rib and Round rib!

The Round rib version is designed to cup over the ribcage and place compression around the waist, while leaving room for the ribs. This is appropriate for those who have larger or inflexible ribs.

The Conical rib is cut straight from the underbust to waist, and will give you a tapered look with more compression on the floating ribs. This is recommended more for experienced corset wearers and those with a naturally smaller or flexible ribcage.

Both silhouettes are identical from the waist to hips; only the ribcage is affected.

CURVE:

The Gemini corset is designed for experienced corset wearers or those with naturally curvy figures. It is one step curvier than the hourglass corset: where the hourglass has a 6.5" rib spring, the Gemini will have an 8" rib spring. Where the hourglass has a 10" high hip spring, the Gemini has a 14" high hip spring. A customer who can fit the hourglass corset in size 26" should be able to comfortably fit the Gemini in size 24".

 

A LONGLINE LOOK - WITHOUT THE LENGTH:

The Gemini has the look of a longline corset, so it extends down over the hips on the side and accommodates a 16" low hip spring. The longline corset is aesthetically preferred among some corset wearers. The extra smoothing and support over the hip area provides a beautiful silhouette, and in many cases the corset snuggles better under the waistband of slacks and skirts compared to corsets cut high over the hips. However, you don't have to be long-waisted to wear the Gemini, because it's same length as the regular hourglass in the front and along the princess seam! It will fit anyone with a waist length of 9 inches or more. It will fit like a comfortable longline corset for a petite or short-waisted person.

 

EXTRA BONES FOR SUPPORT:

For sizes 22 and larger, the Gemini corset has extra spiral steel bones in the center of some panels to provide extra vertical tension to the corset, preventing wrinkling or buckling of the fabric and ensuring it stays smooth on the body. The spiral steels are still the high quality, flexible, comfortable bones you've come to know from Timeless Trends.

 

HIGHER BACK TO HOLD THE "MUFFIN":

You spoke and we listened! The Gemini corset has a slightly higher back compared to the hourglass corsets, to help hold in the "muffin top" or skin roll-over.

SKU: GCP-208

Our beige 100% cotton corset is the perfect corset for stealthing.  Made with two layers of cotton twill, laminated for strength to a soft 100% cotton outer layer. Even curvier than the Hourglass cut, the Gemini cut is designed for those with naturally curvy figures or experienced corset wearers. Comes with 6 garter tabs. Garter straps sold separately.


Your hips must be at least 10 inches greater than your waist to fit the Gemini Corset.

 

Sizing info:

(If you need help, we have agents in 3 different time zones ready to help you! Reach out to support@timeless-trends.com )

Start by finding the corset size that corresponds to your natural waist measurement, then size up or down to get the best fit at the hips and underbust.

  • the corset should match your ribs and hip measurements as best as possible.
  • It is normal for the corset waist to be smaller than your natural waist.

We recommend a lacing gap of 1" to 3" for comfort and adjustability during the day. We do not recommend anything larger than a 3" lacing gap.

For information on how to measure yourself to get the best fit watch our video:

Not sure about your size? Reach out to us at support@timeless-trends.com !

 

More about the Gemini Corset:

TWO SILHOUETTES TO CHOOSE FROM:

The Gemini corset is offered in two silhouettes: Conical rib and Round rib!

The Round rib version is designed to cup over the ribcage and place compression around the waist, while leaving room for the ribs. This is appropriate for those who have larger or inflexible ribs.

The Conical rib is cut straight from the underbust to waist, and will give you a tapered look with more compression on the floating ribs. This is recommended more for experienced corset wearers and those with a naturally smaller or flexible ribcage.

Both silhouettes are identical from the waist to hips; only the ribcage is affected.

CURVE:

The Gemini corset is designed for experienced corset wearers or those with naturally curvy figures. It is one step curvier than the hourglass corset: where the hourglass has a 6.5" rib spring, the Gemini will have an 8" rib spring. Where the hourglass has a 10" high hip spring, the Gemini has a 14" high hip spring. A customer who can fit the hourglass corset in size 26" should be able to comfortably fit the Gemini in size 24".

 

A LONGLINE LOOK - WITHOUT THE LENGTH:

The Gemini has the look of a longline corset, so it extends down over the hips on the side and accommodates a 16" low hip spring. The longline corset is aesthetically preferred among some corset wearers. The extra smoothing and support over the hip area provides a beautiful silhouette, and in many cases the corset snuggles better under the waistband of slacks and skirts compared to corsets cut high over the hips. However, you don't have to be long-waisted to wear the Gemini, because it's same length as the regular hourglass in the front and along the princess seam! It will fit anyone with a waist length of 9 inches or more. It will fit like a comfortable longline corset for a petite or short-waisted person.

 

EXTRA BONES FOR SUPPORT:

For sizes 22 and larger, the Gemini corset has extra spiral steel bones in the center of some panels to provide extra vertical tension to the corset, preventing wrinkling or buckling of the fabric and ensuring it stays smooth on the body. The spiral steels are still the high quality, flexible, comfortable bones you've come to know from Timeless Trends.

 

HIGHER BACK TO HOLD THE "MUFFIN":

You spoke and we listened! The Gemini corset has a slightly higher back compared to the hourglass corsets, to help hold in the "muffin top" or skin roll-over.

Daisies are like a ray of sunshine to your wardrobe. Uplift your collection with our Daisies at Sunset corset. This corset has been beautifully crafted with red fine cotton and hints of white, light orange, and baby blue! With final added touches of matching satin trim and red satin ribbons to complete this colorful corset. 

The Hourglass silhouette can, if desired, reduce the waistline by up to 6 inches. Ideal for those desiring a dramatic waistline, waist training, stealthing or as a fashion piece.

Sizing overview

Now three ways to confirm your size!

  1. Check whether your body type is generally compatible
  2. Take your measurements and follow our size chart

Sizing charts

We recommend a 1.5" to 3" lacing gap for comfort and adjustability during the day. We do not recommend anything larger than a 3" lacing gap.

About the Gemini Corset:

More about the Gemini Corset:

TWO SILHOUETTES TO CHOOSE FROM:

The Gemini corset is offered in two silhouettes: Conical rib and Round rib!

The Round rib version is designed to cup over the ribcage and place compression around the waist, while leaving room for the ribs. This is appropriate for those who have larger or inflexible ribs.

The Conical rib is cut straight from the underbust to waist, and will give you a tapered look with more compression on the floating ribs. This is recommended more for experienced corset wearers and those with a naturally smaller or flexible ribcage.

Both silhouettes are identical from the waist to hips; only the ribcage is affected.

CURVE:

The Gemini corset is designed for experienced corset wearers or those with naturally curvy figures. It is one step curvier than the hourglass corset: where the hourglass has a 6.5" rib spring, the Gemini will have an 8" rib spring. Where the hourglass has a 10" high hip spring, the Gemini has a 14" high hip spring. A customer who can fit the hourglass corset in size 26" should be able to comfortably fit the Gemini in size 24".

 

A LONGLINE LOOK - WITHOUT THE LENGTH:

The Gemini has the look of a longline corset, so it extends down over the hips on the side and accommodates a 16" low hip spring. The longline corset is aesthetically preferred among some corset wearers. The extra smoothing and support over the hip area provides a beautiful silhouette, and in many cases the corset snuggles better under the waistband of slacks and skirts compared to corsets cut high over the hips. However, you don't have to be long-waisted to wear the Gemini, because it's same length as the regular hourglass in the front and along the princess seam! It will fit anyone with a waist length of 9 inches or more. It will fit like a comfortable longline corset for a petite or short-waisted person.

 

EXTRA BONES FOR SUPPORT:

For sizes 22 and larger, the Gemini corset has extra spiral steel bones in the center of some panels to provide extra vertical tension to the corset, preventing wrinkling or buckling of the fabric and ensuring it stays smooth on the body. The spiral steels are still the high quality, flexible, comfortable bones you've come to know from Timeless Trends.

 

HIGHER BACK TO HOLD THE "MUFFIN":

You spoke and we listened! The Gemini corset has a slightly higher back compared to the hourglass corsets, to help hold in the "muffin top" or skin roll-over.

deep-forest-green-satin-cupped-corset-ge.body_html:
SKU: GCL- 648

This Deep Forest Green satin corset exudes elegance and sophistication. Crafted from smooth, lustrous satin, it features delicate matching ribbons and trim that enhance its luxurious feel. The rich green hue evokes a sense of depth and mystery, making it the perfect addition to any wardrobe for a flattering, timeless silhouette. Available in Gemini Cupped Long and Overbust Hourglass.

Even curvier than the Hourglass cut, the Gemini cut is designed for those with naturally curvy figures or experienced corset wearers. Comes with 6 garter tabs. Garter straps sold separately.

Your high hip must be at least 10 inches greater than your waist to fit the Gemini Corset.

The Gemini Long is perfect for pear-shaped individuals who have a naturally narrow ribcage, who are high waisted, and who have a more gradual and sloping hip spring (one does not need a "high, square hip-shelf" in order to wear the Gemini Long!)

Careful patterning and rigorous testing has been performed on the Gemini Long in order to ensure that the lower abdomen is pulled in and supported without significant bowing or exaggeration of any "tummy pooch". This is perfect for those who have experienced pregnancy or significant weight loss and are looking to flatten their lower tummy apron.

Where the Hourglass Long is for "low waisted" individuals (longer from the waist up and a little shorter from the waist down, to allow wearers with a shallow pelvis to sit down easily without the bottom edge of the corset hitting their lap), the Gemini Long is the opposite, designed for "higher waisted" bodies (longer from the waist down and shorter from the waist up, so that the lower tummy is fully covered, while not pushing up on the bustline unnaturally).

Where the Hourglass Long has side hip ties, the Gemini is closed on the hip, so those who are looking for a stealthy appearance under clothing will appreciate its smoothness, and those who have sensitive hips don't have to worry about any ribbon leaving imprints over the hip bones.

 

The Gemini Long Cupped (Round) rib version is designed to cup over the ribcage and place compression around the waist, while leaving room for the ribs. This is appropriate for those who have larger or inflexible ribs.

 


CURVE:

The Gemini Long corset is designed for experienced corset wearers or those with naturally curvy figures. It is one step curvier than the hourglass corset: where the hourglass has a 6.5" rib spring, the Gemini will have an 8.5" rib spring. Where the hourglass has a 10" high hip spring, the Gemini has a 14" high hip spring, with a 16" lower hip spring. A customer who can fit the hourglass corset in size 26" should be able to comfortably fit the Gemini in size 24".

EXTRA BONES FOR SUPPORT:

For sizes 22 and larger, the Gemini corset has extra spiral steel bones in the center of some panels to provide extra vertical tension to the corset, preventing wrinkling or buckling of the fabric and ensuring it stays smooth on the body. The spiral steels are still the high quality, flexible, comfortable bones you've come to know from Timeless Trends.

* Why do we insist on a lacing gap for our overbusts?
A lacing gap makes sure that the "dip" at the side seam will align with your armpit. Imagine the bottom of the armscye where a sleeve is placed in a shirt. You don't want the arm hole to be too forward or too back!
Our hourglass overbusts also have a high back to help smooth any "muffin" and this part should rest over your shoulder blades. If they are too far back they can lead to more rolls, not less! So a gap is recommended. All of our overbust corsets come with a free laced-in modesty panel to protect your back and look great.

A fan favorite fabric, our fashionable Asian brocade fabric's green and gold tones make for a stunning cosplay corset and add a touch of opulence to any ensemble.

Love the fabric but can't find it in your silhouette? Special order this fabric in the corset that fits your body. How To Special Order

Laced with matching single faced satin ribbon, this corset will give you the curves you deserve.


About the Gemini Corset:

Your hips must be at least 10 inches greater than your waist to fit the Gemini Corset.


CURVE:

The Gemini corset is designed for experienced corset wearers or those with naturally curvy figures. It is one step curvier than the hourglass corset: where the hourglass has a 6.5" rib spring, the Gemini will have an 8" rib spring. Where the hourglass has a 10" high hip spring, the Gemini has a 14" high hip spring. A customer who can fit the hourglass corset in size 26" should be able to comfortably fit the Gemini in size 24".

A LONGLINE LOOK - WITHOUT THE LENGTH:

The Gemini has the look of a longline corset, so it extends down over the hips on the side and accommodates a 16" low hip spring. The longline corset is aesthetically preferred among some corset wearers. The extra smoothing and support over the hip area provides a beautiful silhouette, and in many cases the corset snuggles better under the waistband of slacks and skirts compared to corsets cut high over the hips. However, you don't have to be long-waisted to wear the Gemini, because it's same length as the regular hourglass in the front and along the princess seam! It will fit anyone with a waist length of 9 inches or more. It will fit like a comfortable longline corset for a petite or short-waisted person.

EXTRA BONES FOR SUPPORT:

For sizes 22 and larger, the Gemini corset has extra spiral steel bones in the center of some panels to provide extra vertical tension to the corset, preventing wrinkling or buckling of the fabric and ensuring it stays smooth on the body. The spiral steels are still the high quality, flexible, comfortable bones you've come to know from Timeless Trends.

HIGHER BACK TO HOLD THE "MUFFIN":

You spoke and we listened! The Gemini corset has a slightly higher back compared to the hourglass corsets, to help hold in the "muffin top" or skin roll-over.

Our fashionable Asian brocade corset's green and gold pattern make it a popular favorite, especially among the cosplay crowd! An opulent corset in our over bust cut, this body shaper has a 3-point fitting system that conforms to your waist, bust, and hips to ensure a customized fit right for you and your shape.  

Love the fabric but can't find it in your silhouette?  Special order this fabric in the corset that fits your body.  How To Special Order 

  • Constructed with 20 flexible spiral steel stays for added comfort and better form

  • 6 spring steel stays supporting the grommets and busk

  • ½ inch wide flexible steel busk front closure

  • 3 layers of fabric:

    Outer layer of fabric constructed from poly-silk satin

    Middle layer laminated to outer layer of fabric for added strength and a smooth finish

  • Waist tape for added support at the waist line

  • 4 garter loops (garter straps sold separately)

  • Comes with either an attached modesty panel in black cotton twill or a floating modesty panel in matching solid emerald satin

  • Laced with green ribbon

  • Lifetime guarantee!

emerald-straight-corset-gemini-silhouett.body_html:
SKU: GST-028

A fan favorite fabric, our fashionable Asian brocade fabric's green and gold tones make for a stunning cosplay corset and add a touch of opulence to any ensemble.

Even curvier than the Hourglass cut, the Gemini cut is designed for those with naturally curvy figures or experienced corset wearers. Comes with 6 garter tabs. Garter straps sold separately.

About the Gemini Corset:

 Your hips must be at least 10 inches greater than your waist to fit the Gemini Corset.

TWO SILHOUETTES TO CHOOSE FROM:

The Gemini corset is offered in two silhouettes: Straight and Cupped!

The Cupped (Round rib) version is designed to cup over the ribcage and place compression around the waist, while leaving room for the ribs. This is appropriate for those who have larger or inflexible ribs.

The Straight (Conical rib) is cut straight from the underbust to waist, and will give you a tapered look with more compression on the floating ribs. This is recommended more for experienced corset wearers and those with a naturally smaller or flexible ribcage.

Both silhouettes are identical from the waist to hips; only the ribcage is affected.

CURVE:

The Gemini corset is designed for experienced corset wearers or those with naturally curvy figures. It is one step curvier than the hourglass corset: where the hourglass has a 6.5" rib spring, the Gemini will have an 8" rib spring. Where the hourglass has a 10" high hip spring, the Gemini has a 14" high hip spring. A customer who can fit the hourglass corset in size 26" should be able to comfortably fit the Gemini in size 24".

A LONGLINE LOOK - WITHOUT THE LENGTH:

The Gemini has the look of a longline corset, so it extends down over the hips on the side and accommodates a 16" low hip spring. The longline corset is aesthetically preferred among some corset wearers. The extra smoothing and support over the hip area provides a beautiful silhouette, and in many cases the corset snuggles better under the waistband of slacks and skirts compared to corsets cut high over the hips. However, you don't have to be long-waisted to wear the Gemini, because it's same length as the regular hourglass in the front and along the princess seam! It will fit anyone with a waist length of 9 inches or more. It will fit like a comfortable longline corset for a petite or short-waisted person.

EXTRA BONES FOR SUPPORT:

For sizes 22 and larger, the Gemini corset has extra spiral steel bones in the center of some panels to provide extra vertical tension to the corset, preventing wrinkling or buckling of the fabric and ensuring it stays smooth on the body. The spiral steels are still the high quality, flexible, comfortable bones you've come to know from Timeless Trends.

HIGHER BACK TO HOLD THE "MUFFIN":

You spoke and we listened! The Gemini corset has a slightly higher back compared to the hourglass corsets, to help hold in the "muffin top" or skin roll-over.

Sizing overview

Now three ways to confirm your size!

  1. Check whether your body type is generally compatible
  2. Take your measurements and follow our size chart
  3. Try the sizing bot (shared with permission from Lucy's Corsetry!)
  4. Still not sure? Reach out to us at support@timeless-trends.com !

 

 

Sizing charts

Start by finding the corset size that corresponds to your natural waist measurement, then size up or down to get the best fit at the hips and underbust. You want a snug fit at the underbust and hips with the compression at the waist.

We recommend a 1.5" to 3" lacing gap for comfort and adjustability during the day. We do not recommend anything larger than a 3" lacing gap.

For information on how to measure yourself to get the best fit watch our video:

expander-panel.body_html:
SKU: AXP-XXX

 

Get a 50% savings when paired with the purchase of any corset! Only $16.48 when added to your corset order!

Corset in your stash just a little too small for comfort? Our revolutionary expander panel will increase the size of your corset by one size (2 inches) or two sizes (4 inches)!

The inky black cashmere finish is an ideal match for your black cashmere (003) and black cotton (084) corsets.

The beige cotton finish will match the fabric on our beige cotton (208) corsets.

Compatibility Guide:

Functional and pretty

Same busk length 10", and similar fabric length 12".
  • Hourglass Regular (UHR)
  • Novice (NHR)
  • Hourglass Regular w/ hip ties (UHR-WT)
  • Slim Regular (USR)

Functional, not pretty (still works!)

Same busk length 10", NOT the same fabric length. 
  • Gemini Regular (GST, GCP)
  • New Funnel Rib (UFR)

Not functional / not compatible

Different length busk - will not clasp.
  • All short corsets (UHS, USS)
  • All long corsets (UHL, USL, GSL, GCL)
  • All overbusts (OSR, OHN)

 

While our production team is very good at what they do, due to the natural variability in construction, we cannot guarantee precision that the trim edges will match up within 1mm. (Please see the black expander with our black velvet corset for an example of a good match, and the beige expander with the beige Novice corset for a less perfect match.)

To ensure as close a match as possible, we advise ordering an expander panel at the same time as your corset, so they can be constructed in at the same time to match.

We do not guarantee compatibility with any other corset brand.

 

Why expander panels and how do they work?

We honor our bodies' natural fluctuations. During times of feast or lack, peace or stress, or changes in our hormones, our size may go up and down.

Our Corset Expander Panels work by adding extra inches to the front of the corset. This allows the side seams of the corset to hit the sides of your body, and creates a smaller lacing gap in the back, which will enable you to lace up your corset easily.

Please use expanders one at a time (do not link multiple expanders together). Not to be used as a pregnancy expander; we do not recommend the use of corsets during pregnancy for any reason.

 

Instructions for Use

(We are not responsible for damage to your corset busk or to the expander due to  misuse.)


How to put on:

                     

When putting on the corset, clasp it to your corset carefully and with a mirror, ensuring ALL 10 loops and pins are thoroughly fastened before tightening the corset.

We find it's helpful to loop an elastic band around one side of the fastened busks to keep it in place while fastening the other side:


How to take off:
When taking off the corset, ensure your laces are extremely loose and unclasp the expander slowly and carefully, preferably with a mirror, to open and take off the corset. Do not twist or yank, as this will damage the busks.

 

Expander panels and all other accessories are Final Sale, not eligible for exchange or return. We will grant an exception and allow a return if you purchase your expander panel for an older UHR, NHR, or USR corset (more than 10 years old) and the busk clasps do not match up perfectly.

Lifetime Guarantee extends to the seams and boning; busk portion is not eligible for warranty in the expander panels in the case of misuse or abuse. Please use responsibly.

extended-size-collection-1.body_html:
We’re excited to announce the launch of our new Extended Size Collection, in collaboration with Lucy's Corsetry! This collection is thoughtfully designed to fit and flatter natural waist sizes up to 65 inches.

We carry waist sizes 16" up to 42" in our regular catalog. Please note this listing is for sizes 44 inch, 46 inch, 48 inch, and 50 inch closed waist, which may fit natural waists up to 65 inches.

To ensure the best fit and support, we strongly recommend complimentary fitting consultation for customers selecting from our extended size range. Our team is here to guide you every step of the way and help you find the perfect corset for your body and style. For assistance, please contact us at support@timeless-trends.com.

Read more about Lucy's thoughtful design and testing process.

Eight silhouettes:

The Extended Size Collection is available 8 of our most popular silhouettes:

  1. Hourglass Regular
  2. Hourglass Long
  3. Hourglass Short
  4. Slim Regular
  5. Slim Long
  6. Gemini Straight Long
  7. Overbust Hourglass
  8. Overbust Slim

Raised waistline:

Our corsets in size 44" and larger have been modified with a shorter length from waist up, and longer length from waist to lap. This provides enhanced coverage and superior support for the lower abdominal region, ensuring a flawless fit and serious comfort for the discerning wearer.

Smaller rib spring:

Our full figured clientele typically have an underbust measurement several inches smaller than their natural waistline. This is a perfectly natural and common occurrence. Our meticulously designed Extended Collection has been engineered with a smaller and tapered rib to accommodate your proportions, providing an impeccable fit that elegantly embraces your curves while minimizing any unwanted flare at the upper edge.

Taller and wider back:

In some of our silhouettes, the back was raised and adjusted to hold and accommodate any upper back spill from natural flesh distribution (the "squish factor"), creating a smooth finish over or under clothing.

Heavy duty busk:

All of our corsets in sizes 40" and up have an extra wide busk, providing superior abdominal support and a smooth profile view.

Additional bones:

Our Extended Size Collection incorporates 32 to 36 bones (varying by style and size) rather than the standard 26 bones, providing enhanced support for wider panels. The additional flexible spiral steels keep wrinkles at bay while maintaining exceptional flexibility, ensuring a flawless silhouette that gracefully accentuates your natural curves.

Equitable pricing:

We believe that bigger bodies should not be punished with higher prices. We have gone to great measures to keep our extended sizes at the same price as our other catalog corsets for now, absorbing the cost of the extra fabric and hardware used to create these timeless pieces. However, we can not guarantee how long our catalog prices will remain at 2022 pricing, so order soon!

Our Black Cashmere and Beige Cotton colorways are eligible for return within 30 days, just like our other catalog corsets! If you would like to order your extended size corset in one of our other gorgeous fabrics, reach out to our customer care team and we will make your corset dreams come true. Special orders are subject to our special order pricing and are Final Sale (not eligible for exchange or return).

Photo credits (hourglass short, hourglass overbust, and slim overbust): we extend our thanks to @njaycphotography

SKU: GST-167

Cool, sleek, fine. This mesh corset will give you the compression, fit and curves you deserve while keeping you at the just the right temperature. The front and back panels, boning channels, and trim are made from a matte black satin. The lacing is made from matching black satin ribbon. 

 

Add a black satin modesty panel or other accessories to your order and save. Accessories

About the Gemini Corset:

Your hips must be at least 10 inches greater than your waist to fit the Gemini Corset. 

TWO SILHOUETTES TO CHOOSE FROM:

The Gemini corset is offered in two silhouettes: Conical (Straight) rib and Round (Cupped) rib!

The Round (Cupped) rib version is designed to cup over the ribcage and place compression around the waist, while leaving room for the ribs. This is appropriate for those who have larger or inflexible ribs.

The Conical (Straight) rib is cut straight from the underbust to waist, and will give you a tapered look with more compression on the floating ribs. This is recommended more for experienced corset wearers and those with a naturally smaller or flexible ribcage.

Both silhouettes are identical from the waist to hips; only the ribcage is affected.

CURVE:

The Gemini corset is designed for experienced corset wearers or those with naturally curvy figures. It is one step curvier than the hourglass corset: where the hourglass has a 6.5" rib spring, the Gemini will have an 8" rib spring. Where the hourglass has a 10" high hip spring, the Gemini has a 14" high hip spring. A customer who can fit the hourglass corset in size 26" should be able to comfortably fit the Gemini in size 24".

A LONGLINE LOOK - WITHOUT THE LENGTH:

The Gemini has the look of a longline corset, so it extends down over the hips on the side and accommodates a 16" low hip spring. The longline corset is aesthetically preferred among some corset wearers. The extra smoothing and support over the hip area provides a beautiful silhouette, and in many cases the corset snuggles better under the waistband of slacks and skirts compared to corsets cut high over the hips. However, you don't have to be long-waisted to wear the Gemini, because it's same length as the regular hourglass in the front and along the princess seam! It will fit anyone with a waist length of 9 inches or more. It will fit like a comfortable longline corset for a petite or short-waisted person.


        

      Corset pattern designed in collaboration with Lucy's Corsetry!

      Sizing overview

      Now three ways to confirm your size!

      1. Check whether your body type is generally compatible
      2. Take your measurements and follow our size chart

      4. Still not sure? Reach out to us at support@timeless-trends.com !

      We recommend a 1.5" to 3" lacing gap for comfort and adjustability during the day. We do not recommend anything larger than a 3" lacing gap.

The Gemini has the look of a longline corset, so it extends down over the hips on the side and accommodates a 16" low hip spring. The extra smoothing and support over the hip area provides a beautiful silhouette, and in many cases the corset snuggles better under the waistband of slacks and skirts compared to corsets cut high over the hips. However, you don't have to be long-waisted to wear the Gemini, because it's same length as the regular hourglass in the front and along the princess seam! It will fit anyone with a waist length of 9 inches or more. It will fit like a comfortable longline corset for a petite or short-waisted person.

The longline corset is aesthetically preferred among some corset wearers. The extra smoothing and support over the hip area provides a beautiful silhouette, and in many cases the corset snuggles better under the waistband of slacks and skirts compared to corsets cut high over the hips. However, you don't have to be long-waisted to wear the Gemini, because it's same length as the regular hourglass in the front and along the princess seam! It will fit anyone with a waist length of 9 inches or more. It will fit like a comfortable longline corset for a petite or short-waisted person.

 

EXTRA BONES FOR SUPPORT:

For sizes 22 and larger, the Gemini corset has extra spiral steel bones in the center of some panels to provide extra vertical tension to the corset, preventing wrinkling or buckling of the fabric and ensuring it stays smooth on the body. The spiral steels are still the high quality, flexible, comfortable bones you've come to know from Timeless Trends.

 

HIGHER BACK TO HOLD THE "MUFFIN":

You spoke and we listened! The Gemini corset has a slightly higher back compared to the hourglass corsets, to help hold in the "muffin top" or skin roll-over.

About the Gemini Corset:

Your hips must be at least 10 inches greater than your waist to fit the Gemini Corset.

 

Sizing info:

More about the Gemini Corset:

TWO SILHOUETTES TO CHOOSE FROM:

The Gemini corset is offered in two silhouettes: Conical rib and Round rib!

The Round rib version is designed to cup over the ribcage and place compression around the waist, while leaving room for the ribs. This is appropriate for those who have larger or inflexible ribs.

The Conical rib is cut straight from the underbust to waist, and will give you a tapered look with more compression on the floating ribs. This is recommended more for experienced corset wearers and those with a naturally smaller or flexible ribcage.

Both silhouettes are identical from the waist to hips; only the ribcage is affected.

CURVE:

The Gemini corset is designed for experienced corset wearers or those with naturally curvy figures. It is one step curvier than the hourglass corset: where the hourglass has a 6.5" rib spring, the Gemini will have an 8" rib spring. Where the hourglass has a 10" high hip spring, the Gemini has a 14" high hip spring. A customer who can fit the hourglass corset in size 26" should be able to comfortably fit the Gemini in size 24".

 

A LONGLINE LOOK - WITHOUT THE LENGTH:

The Gemini has the look of a longline corset, so it extends down over the hips on the side and accommodates a 16" low hip spring. The longline corset is aesthetically preferred among some corset wearers. The extra smoothing and support over the hip area provides a beautiful silhouette, and in many cases the corset snuggles better under the waistband of slacks and skirts compared to corsets cut high over the hips. However, you don't have to be long-waisted to wear the Gemini, because it's same length as the regular hourglass in the front and along the princess seam! It will fit anyone with a waist length of 9 inches or more. It will fit like a comfortable longline corset for a petite or short-waisted person.

 

EXTRA BONES FOR SUPPORT:

For sizes 22 and larger, the Gemini corset has extra spiral steel bones in the center of some panels to provide extra vertical tension to the corset, preventing wrinkling or buckling of the fabric and ensuring it stays smooth on the body. The spiral steels are still the high quality, flexible, comfortable bones you've come to know from Timeless Trends.

 

HIGHER BACK TO HOLD THE "MUFFIN":

You spoke and we listened! The Gemini corset has a slightly higher back compared to the hourglass corsets, to help hold in the "muffin top" or skin roll-over.

The Libby is identical to the Libra in every way except the waist reduction is less dramatic. In the years since the Libra was released, we noticed that there was a real need for a less extreme version. The Libby is a perfect "stepping stone" corset for those who want to waist train and eventually graduate to the original Libra. Ideal for "ruler" or "apple" shaped wearers, or muscular wearers who don't have a lot of squish.

Through clever design, the Libby still looks surprisingly curvy and does not give a "straight" figure. This is why we prefer to call it the Libra Gentle, or just "Libby", instead of the Libra Slim.

  • If you wear the original Libra with a small lacing gap: go up 1 size in the Libby
  • If you wear the original Libra laced closed: go up 2 sizes in the Libby

If you're ever not sure about your size, reach out to us at support@timeless-trends.com !

Its length is versatile; with a princess seam of 9 inches, it is shorter than a regular underbust corset but longer than a waspie. For more information about the Libra and Libby, check out our page: Libra Silhouette

About the Gemini Corset:

Sizing info:

(If you need help, we have agents in 3 different time zones ready to help you! Reach out to support@timeless-trends.com )

Start by finding the corset size that corresponds to your natural waist measurement, then size up or down to get the best fit at the hips and underbust.

  • the corset should match your ribs and hip measurements as best as possible.
  • It is normal for the corset waist to be smaller than your natural waist.

We recommend a lacing gap of 1" to 3" for comfort and adjustability during the day. We do not recommend anything larger than a 3" lacing gap.

More about the Gemini Corset:

TWO SILHOUETTES TO CHOOSE FROM:

The Gemini corset is offered in two silhouettes: Conical rib and Round rib!

The Round rib version is designed to cup over the ribcage and place compression around the waist, while leaving room for the ribs. This is appropriate for those who have larger or inflexible ribs.

The Conical rib is cut straight from the underbust to waist, and will give you a tapered look with more compression on the floating ribs. This is recommended more for experienced corset wearers and those with a naturally smaller or flexible ribcage.

Both silhouettes are identical from the waist to hips; only the ribcage is affected.

CURVE:

The Gemini corset is designed for experienced corset wearers or those with naturally curvy figures. It is one step curvier than the hourglass corset: where the hourglass has a 6.5" rib spring, the Gemini will have an 8" rib spring. Where the hourglass has a 10" high hip spring, the Gemini has a 14" high hip spring. A customer who can fit the hourglass corset in size 26" should be able to comfortably fit the Gemini in size 24".

 

A LONGLINE LOOK - WITHOUT THE LENGTH:

The Gemini has the look of a longline corset, so it extends down over the hips on the side and accommodates a 16" low hip spring. The longline corset is aesthetically preferred among some corset wearers. The extra smoothing and support over the hip area provides a beautiful silhouette, and in many cases the corset snuggles better under the waistband of slacks and skirts compared to corsets cut high over the hips. However, you don't have to be long-waisted to wear the Gemini, because it's same length as the regular hourglass in the front and along the princess seam! It will fit anyone with a waist length of 9 inches or more. It will fit like a comfortable longline corset for a petite or short-waisted person.

 

EXTRA BONES FOR SUPPORT:

For sizes 22 and larger, the Gemini corset has extra spiral steel bones in the center of some panels to provide extra vertical tension to the corset, preventing wrinkling or buckling of the fabric and ensuring it stays smooth on the body. The spiral steels are still the high quality, flexible, comfortable bones you've come to know from Timeless Trends.

 

HIGHER BACK TO HOLD THE "MUFFIN":

You spoke and we listened! The Gemini corset has a slightly higher back compared to the hourglass corsets, to help hold in the "muffin top" or skin roll-over.
