The Impressionist Shimmer corset is exquisitely crafted from synthetic fabric, featuring soft iridescent hues that ripple across the surface like brushstrokes on a canvas. A pastel blend of purples, blues, golds, and pinks creates a dreamy, luminous effect that shifts beautifully with the light.

Perfect for fantasy photoshoots, fairs, events, and Halloween, this corset brings an artistic elegance to any outfit. Designed to support your figure and define your waist with both beauty and comfort, it is available in three silhouettes: Gemini, Hourglass Regular with Hip Ties, and Overbust Hourglass.

Love the fabric but can't find it in your silhouette?  Special order this fabric in the corset that fits your body.  How To Special Order

About the Gemini Corset:

Your hips must be at least 10 inches greater than your waist to fit the Gemini Corset.

 

Sizing info:

(If you need help, we have agents in 3 different time zones ready to help you! Reach out to support@timeless-trends.com )

Start by finding the corset size that corresponds to your natural waist measurement, then size up or down to get the best fit at the hips and underbust.

  • the corset should match your ribs and hip measurements as best as possible.
  • It is normal for the corset waist to be smaller than your natural waist.

We recommend a lacing gap of 1" to 3" for comfort and adjustability during the day. We do not recommend anything larger than a 3" lacing gap.

For information on how to measure yourself to get the best fit watch our video:

More about the Gemini Corset:

TWO SILHOUETTES TO CHOOSE FROM:

The Gemini corset is offered in two silhouettes: Conical rib and Round rib!

The Round rib version is designed to cup over the ribcage and place compression around the waist, while leaving room for the ribs. This is appropriate for those who have larger or inflexible ribs.

The Conical rib is cut straight from the underbust to waist, and will give you a tapered look with more compression on the floating ribs. This is recommended more for experienced corset wearers and those with a naturally smaller or flexible ribcage.

Both silhouettes are identical from the waist to hips; only the ribcage is affected.

CURVE:

The Gemini corset is designed for experienced corset wearers or those with naturally curvy figures. It is one step curvier than the hourglass corset: where the hourglass has a 6.5" rib spring, the Gemini will have an 8" rib spring. Where the hourglass has a 10" high hip spring, the Gemini has a 14" high hip spring. A customer who can fit the hourglass corset in size 26" should be able to comfortably fit the Gemini in size 24".

 

A LONGLINE LOOK - WITHOUT THE LENGTH:

The Gemini has the look of a longline corset, so it extends down over the hips on the side and accommodates a 16" low hip spring. The longline corset is aesthetically preferred among some corset wearers. The extra smoothing and support over the hip area provides a beautiful silhouette, and in many cases the corset snuggles better under the waistband of slacks and skirts compared to corsets cut high over the hips. However, you don't have to be long-waisted to wear the Gemini, because it's same length as the regular hourglass in the front and along the princess seam! It will fit anyone with a waist length of 9 inches or more. It will fit like a comfortable longline corset for a petite or short-waisted person.

 

EXTRA BONES FOR SUPPORT:

For sizes 22 and larger, the Gemini corset has extra spiral steel bones in the center of some panels to provide extra vertical tension to the corset, preventing wrinkling or buckling of the fabric and ensuring it stays smooth on the body. The spiral steels are still the high quality, flexible, comfortable bones you've come to know from Timeless Trends.

 

HIGHER BACK TO HOLD THE "MUFFIN":

You spoke and we listened! The Gemini corset has a slightly higher back compared to the hourglass corsets, to help hold in the "muffin top" or skin roll-over.

* Why do we insist on a lacing gap for our overbusts?

✨ Timeless Trends continues its partnership with Lucy Corsetry! 👗💫

After hearing lots of feedback about the Underbust Hourglass Regular (UHR), Lucy designed the UFR: Underbust, Funnel, Regular. The UFR keeps the same length, rib, and hip spring as our Hourglass Regular, but with a few thoughtful tweaks:

  • Straight (funnel) rib: The biggest difference—gives a tapered, sleek look.
  • Smoother lower tummy: Less pointed at the center front, making it sit better under clothing.
  • Squared upper back: Reduces “muffin top” around the shoulder blades.
  • Adjusted waistline: UFR is 5" from waist to underbust and 5" from waist to lower edge (compared to 5.5" and 4.5" on UHR), so shorter above the waist and slightly longer below.
  • Enhanced waist-to-hip curve: A slightly more convex shape and a bit longer on the hip for added comfort, especially for those with sensitive hip bones.

🖤 Currently available in Black Cotton, Beige Cotton, Black Fine Mesh No Line, and Beige Fine Mesh No Line fabrics.

 


Sizing overview

Now three ways to confirm your size!

  1. Check whether your body type is generally compatible
  2. Take your measurements and follow our size chart
  3. Try the sizing bot (shared with permission from Lucy's Corsetry!)
  4. Still not sure? Reach out to us at support@timeless-trends.com !

  

Sizing charts

We recommend a 1.5" to 3" lacing gap for comfort and adjustability during the day. We do not recommend anything larger than a 3" lacing gap.

nude-straight-corset-gemini-silhouette-r.body_html:
SKU: GST-253 / Manuf #: LGStraight-Nude

The creme cotton fashion fabric featured here in our fabulous Gemini Silhouette is an excellent choice for shapewear, casual, or classic ensembles. Even curvier than the Hourglass cut, the Gemini cut is designed for those with naturally curvy figures or experienced corset wearers. Comes with 6 garter tabs. Garter straps sold separately.

 

Your hips must be at least 10 inches greater than your waist to fit the Gemini Corset.

 

About the Gemini Corset:

  • Corset pattern designed in collaboration with Lucy's Corsetry!
  • Constructed with 20 flexible spiral steel stays for added comfort and better form
  • 6 spring steel stays supporting the grommets and busk
  • Two part ½ inch wide flexible steel busk front closure, overall width 1 inch
  • Matching front modesty placket under the busk
  • 3 layers of fabric:
    • 2 inner layers constructed from high quality cotton twill
    • Outer layer of fabric constructed from 100% wool
    • Middle layer laminated to outer layer of fabric for added strength and a smooth finish
  • Waist tape for added support at the waist line

 

TWO SILHOUETTES TO CHOOSE FROM:

The Gemini corset is offered in two silhouettes: Conical rib and Round rib!

The Round rib version is designed to cup over the ribcage and place compression around the waist, while leaving room for the ribs. This is appropriate for those who have larger or inflexible ribs.

The Conical rib is cut straight from the underbust to waist, and will give you a tapered look with more compression on the floating ribs. This is recommended more for experienced corset wearers and those with a naturally smaller or flexible ribcage.

Both silhouettes are identical from the waist to hips; only the ribcage is affected.

CURVE:

The Gemini corset is designed for experienced corset wearers or those with naturally curvy figures. It is one step curvier than the hourglass corset: where the hourglass has a 6.5" rib spring, the Gemini will have an 8" rib spring. Where the hourglass has a 10" high hip spring, the Gemini has a 12" high hip spring. A customer who can fit the hourglass corset in size 26" should be able to comfortably fit the Gemini in size 24".

 

A LONGLINE LOOK - WITHOUT THE LENGTH:

The Gemini has the look of a longline corset, so it extends down over the hips on the side and accommodates a 16" low hip spring. The longline corset is aesthetically preferred among some corset wearers. The extra smoothing and support over the hip area provides a beautiful silhouette, and in many cases the corset snuggles better under the waistband of slacks and skirts compared to corsets cut high over the hips. However, you don't have to be long-waisted to wear the Gemini, because it's same length as the regular hourglass in the front and along the princess seam! It will fit anyone with a waist length of 9 inches or more. It will fit like a comfortable longline corset for a petite or short-waisted person.

 

EXTRA BONES FOR SUPPORT:

For sizes 22 and larger, the Gemini corset has extra spiral steel bones in the center of some panels to provide extra vertical tension to the corset, preventing wrinkling or buckling of the fabric and ensuring it stays smooth on the body. The spiral steels are still the high quality, flexible, comfortable bones you've come to know from Timeless Trends.

 

HIGHER BACK TO HOLD THE "MUFFIN":

You spoke and we listened! The Gemini corset has a slightly higher back compared to the hourglass corsets, to help hold in the "muffin top" or skin roll-over.

peonies-in-bloom-corset-gemini-silhouett.body_html:
SKU: GSL- 603

The Peonies in Bloom is an elegant and dashing corset with a combination of white cotton fabric contrasting with adorable shades of blooming peach peonies . Create that romantic look to your favourite outfit. Trimmed with matching cotton and laced with peach satin ribbons. Available in three silhouettes: Gemini Cupped Long, Gemini Straight Long, and Overbust Slim.

Our curviest cut yet, cinch your waist down even more and let your hip spring pop with the adjustable hip laces for a dramatic hourglass silhouette that doesn't sacrifice comfort.

Your hips must be at least 10 inches greater than your waist to fit the Gemini Corset.

The Gemini Long is perfect for pear-shaped individuals who have a naturally narrow ribcage, who are high waisted, and who have a more gradual and sloping hip spring (one does not need a "high, square hip-shelf" in order to wear the Gemini Long!)

Careful patterning and rigorous testing has been performed on the Gemini Long in order to ensure that the lower abdomen is pulled in and supported without significant bowing or exaggeration of any "tummy pooch". This is perfect for those who have experienced pregnancy or significant weight loss and are looking to flatten their lower tummy apron.

Where the Hourglass Long is for "low waisted" individuals (longer from the waist up and a little shorter from the waist down, to allow wearers with a shallow pelvis to sit down easily without the bottom edge of the corset hitting their lap), the Gemini Long is the opposite, designed for "higher waisted" bodies (longer from the waist down and shorter from the waist up, so that the lower tummy is fully covered, while not pushing up on the bustline unnaturally).

Where the Hourglass Long has side hip ties, the Gemini is closed on the hip, so those who are looking for a stealthy appearance under clothing will appreciate its smoothness, and those who have sensitive hips don't have to worry about any ribbon leaving imprints over the hip bones.

More about the Gemini Corset:

TWO SILHOUETTES TO CHOOSE FROM:

The Gemini corset is offered in two silhouettes: Conical rib and Round rib!

The Round rib version is designed to cup over the ribcage and place compression around the waist, while leaving room for the ribs. This is appropriate for those who have larger or inflexible ribs.

The Conical rib is cut straight from the underbust to waist, and will give you a tapered look with more compression on the floating ribs. This is recommended more for experienced corset wearers and those with a naturally smaller or flexible ribcage.

Both silhouettes are identical from the waist to hips; only the ribcage is affected.

CURVE:

The Gemini corset is designed for experienced corset wearers or those with naturally curvy figures. It is one step curvier than the hourglass corset: where the hourglass has a 6.5" rib spring, the Gemini will have an 8" rib spring. Where the hourglass has a 10" high hip spring, the Gemini has a 14" high hip spring. A customer who can fit the hourglass corset in size 26" should be able to comfortably fit the Gemini in size 24".

 

A LONGLINE LOOK - WITHOUT THE LENGTH:

The Gemini has the look of a longline corset, so it extends down over the hips on the side and accommodates a 16" low hip spring. The longline corset is aesthetically preferred among some corset wearers. The extra smoothing and support over the hip area provides a beautiful silhouette, and in many cases the corset snuggles better under the waistband of slacks and skirts compared to corsets cut high over the hips. However, you don't have to be long-waisted to wear the Gemini, because it's same length as the regular hourglass in the front and along the princess seam! It will fit anyone with a waist length of 9 inches or more. It will fit like a comfortable longline corset for a petite or short-waisted person.

 

EXTRA BONES FOR SUPPORT:

For sizes 22 and larger, the Gemini corset has extra spiral steel bones in the center of some panels to provide extra vertical tension to the corset, preventing wrinkling or buckling of the fabric and ensuring it stays smooth on the body. The spiral steels are still the high quality, flexible, comfortable bones you've come to know from Timeless Trends.

 

HIGHER BACK TO HOLD THE "MUFFIN":

You spoke and we listened! The Gemini corset has a slightly higher back compared to the hourglass corsets, to help hold in the "muffin top" or skin roll-over.

The Gemini Long is perfect for pear-shaped individuals who have a naturally narrow ribcage, who are high waisted, and who have a more gradual and sloping hip spring (one does not need a "high, square hip-shelf" in order to wear the Gemini Long!)

Where the Hourglass Long has side hip ties, the Gemini is closed on the hip, so those who are looking for a stealthy appearance under clothing will appreciate its smoothness, and those who have sensitive hips don't have to worry about any ribbon leaving imprints over the hip bones.

* Why do we insist on a lacing gap for our overbusts?
A lacing gap makes sure that the "dip" at the side seam will align with your armpit. Imagine the bottom of the armscye where a sleeve is placed in a shirt. You don't want the arm hole to be too forward or too back!
Our hourglass overbusts also have a high back to help smooth any "muffin" and this part should rest over your shoulder blades. If they are too far back they can lead to more rolls, not less! So a gap is recommended. All of our overbust corsets come with a free laced-in modesty panel to protect your back and look great.

rush-for-us-customers.body_html:
US customers, our Rush (Priority turnaround service) is back!

Due to tariffs and import fees, please add one rush upgrade for EACH corset in your order.

Do you have an event quickly approaching? Now you can request a RUSH on your corset order!

Our valued customers know that we are unable to provide express shipping. Our corsets are made fresh and "hot off the press" from our exclusive facility, and shipped directly to you using the fastest international shipping already available.

We appreciate that you may need your corset urgently, so this RUSH upgrade puts control in your hands regarding the process before shipping - having your order pushed to the front of the line.

Rush orders will be shipped direct-to-customer from our factory, rather than imported through our US import services. This reduces fulfillment time by an additional 3-5 business days, getting our corsets to your door at maximum speed! 

The new $25 Rush fee does two things for US Customers:

  1. It pushes your order to the front of the production line, so your corset is sewn up in 1-2 business days, instead of 4-7 business days.
  2. It ships your corset directly to you from our Bangkok factory, Delivered Duty Paid! All tariffs, taxes, duty, and brokerage fees should be fully covered and there should be no additional C.O.D.
    Please note, the addressee name will say "Quitman Inc. ℅ [Customer Name]" where Quitman is the importer of record. 

While we do our best to expedite your order, logistically we cannot promise delivery in less than 3 business days. We cannot control whether UPS delays delivery due to import customs holds. This service is non-refundable.

Please note that Rush requests can not be used on Special Orders or Customized Orders. We need extra time to ensure that we get your order perfect, and in order to avoid production mistakes, this is one instance that should not be rushed. If you request rush on your Special Order, you will be refunded the Rush fee.

Priority service may be different depending on the item ordered:

 In-stock corsets: When possible, we try to keep a small quantity of best-selling sizes in the black and beige cotton corsets. If two customers order the same item of which only one is in stock, the person who requests RUSH will take priority.
Made-to-order corsets: Most of our corsets are made to order and first-come first-served. Standard production times vary from 2-7 business days depending on volume of orders, the size and complexity of your order, and busy/slow seasons. A customer who requests RUSH will have their order prioritized for accelerated production.
"No Line" corsets: Our No Line corsets are complex and require more skill and time to assemble than our standard corsets. A very small team of only our best corsetieres know how to make the No Line corsets with the quality and care we stand behind. A customer who requests RUSH on a No Line corset will have their order pushed to the front of the line, but we respectfully ask our clientele to note that No Line corsets cannot be completed in a single day.

 

This rush upgrade accomplishes three things to benefit everyone:

  1. The rush order is communicated to the admin and factory at the time of purchase, so that it does not disrupt the factory's work flow as when requested in the middle of production.

  2. The rush fee is shared with our factory as a gratuity for accommodating the customer's timeline.

  3. This upgrade helps prevent exploitation of rush requests and customer "leapfrog" (where everyone requests priority service and no one gets ahead).

*Please note that this is a service to jump the customer line. While we do our best to expedite your order, logistically we cannot promise delivery in less than 3 business days. This service is non-refundable.

Glitz, shimmer, shine! The Siren Sequin Mesh corset is crafted from mermaid sequin, black mesh, and black satin, showcasing an iridescent blend of deep ocean greens, teals, and midnight hues. Featuring reversible sequins, one side reveals a matte black finish while the other shifts to a luminous blue green, ensuring you stand out wherever you wear your scales. Inspired by a mermaid aesthetic, it catches the light with every movement, creating a striking, oceanic allure. Like all our corsets, it is backed by our no hassle Lifetime Guarantee. Available in Overbust Hourglass and Libby

The Libra astrology sign represents symmetry and balance. This corset was designed by Lucy's Corsetry as the answer for bodies that have similar measurements for both rib cage and hips.

The Libby is identical to the Libra in every way except the waist reduction is less dramatic. In the years since the Libra was released, we noticed that there was a real need for a less extreme version. The Libby is a perfect "stepping stone" corset for those who want to waist train and eventually graduate to the original Libra. Ideal for "ruler" or "apple" shaped wearers, or muscular wearers who don't have a lot of squish.

Through clever design, the Libby still looks surprisingly curvy and does not give a "straight" figure. This is why we prefer to call it the Libra Gentle, or just "Libby", instead of the Libra Slim.

  • If you wear the original Libra with a small lacing gap: go up 1 size in the Libby
  • If you wear the original Libra laced closed: go up 2 sizes in the Libby

If you're unsure about your size, reach out to us at support@timeless-trends.com !

Its length is versatile; with a princess seam of 9 inches, it is shorter than a regular underbust corset but longer than a waspie. For more information about the Libra and Libby, check out our page: Libra Silhouette

* Why do we insist on a lacing gap for our overbusts?
A lacing gap makes sure that the "dip" at the side seam will align with your armpit. Imagine the bottom of the armscye where a sleeve is placed in a shirt. You don't want the arm hole to be too forward or too back!
Our hourglass overbusts also have a high back to help smooth any "muffin" and this part should rest over your shoulder blades. If they are too far back they can lead to more rolls, not less! So a gap is recommended. All of our overbust corsets come with a free laced-in modesty panel to protect your back and look great.

solaced-101-true-stories-about-corsets-b.body_html:
ABK-SOL-00

Author Lucy Williams, the queen of corsetry, gives us the book that provides modern day insight to corsetry. This eye-opening read gives a fresh perspective on corsetry as it addresses the controversial hype that has since swept the media. With one testimony at a time, Solaced breaks down the persisting myths and stigmas that have labeled this otherwise effective therapeutic method to be outdated, eccentric, or inhumane.

Discover for yourself how the unassuming corset proved to be the long-awaited answer for many: relieving pain for those who suffer from chronic illness and pain disorders; providing physical protection during frightening mugging attempts and shielding blows from abusive ex-partners; soothing those suffering from deep grief, social disorders, anxiety and PTSD; as well as playing a crucial role toward recovery for survivors of vehicle collisions, stroke, and cancer patients alike.

Chosen among thousands of entries, Lucy has carefully compiled these 101 enlightening and uplifting verified stories from real, living corset wearers in the 21st century who have transformed their lives and shown that the corset is a versatile tool—not merely for vanity, but for those seeking alleviation and restoration.

"Therapeutic support and bracing, when combined with a corset’s aesthetic customizability, comfort, luxuriousness, and elegant appeal, may improve patient compliance and encourage faster rehabilitation overall."

Put simply, good health shouldn't be a last resort. Therapeutic corsetry brings together fashion and function; treatment and tailoring; corrective care and couture. The corset wearers herein choose to throw taboo to the wind, and lace themselves in solace.

All sales of this book are final.  This book will be shipped via USPS Media service and separately from other items placed at the same time.  Because of the different service level it may take longer to reach you, or it may show up before your other items.

﻿Solaced is only available for shipment in the USA.

TWO SILHOUETTES TO CHOOSE FROM:

The Gemini corset is offered in two silhouettes: Conical rib and Round rib!

The Round rib version is designed to cup over the ribcage and place compression around the waist, while leaving room for the ribs. This is appropriate for those who have larger or inflexible ribs.

The Conical rib is cut straight from the underbust to waist, and will give you a tapered look with more compression on the floating ribs. This is recommended more for experienced corset wearers and those with a naturally smaller or flexible ribcage.

Both silhouettes are identical from the waist to hips; only the ribcage is affected.

CURVE:

The Gemini corset is designed for experienced corset wearers or those with naturally curvy figures. It is one step curvier than the hourglass corset: where the hourglass has a 6.5" rib spring, the Gemini will have an 8" rib spring. Where the hourglass has a 10" high hip spring, the Gemini has a 14" high hip spring. A customer who can fit the hourglass corset in size 26" should be able to comfortably fit the Gemini in size 24".

 

A LONGLINE LOOK - WITHOUT THE LENGTH:

The Gemini has the look of a longline corset, so it extends down over the hips on the side and accommodates a 16" low hip spring. The longline corset is aesthetically preferred among some corset wearers. The extra smoothing and support over the hip area provides a beautiful silhouette, and in many cases the corset snuggles better under the waistband of slacks and skirts compared to corsets cut high over the hips. However, you don't have to be long-waisted to wear the Gemini, because it's same length as the regular hourglass in the front and along the princess seam! It will fit anyone with a waist length of 9 inches or more. It will fit like a comfortable longline corset for a petite or short-waisted person.

 

EXTRA BONES FOR SUPPORT:

For sizes 22 and larger, the Gemini corset has extra spiral steel bones in the center of some panels to provide extra vertical tension to the corset, preventing wrinkling or buckling of the fabric and ensuring it stays smooth on the body. The spiral steels are still the high quality, flexible, comfortable bones you've come to know from Timeless Trends.

 

HIGHER BACK TO HOLD THE "MUFFIN":

You spoke and we listened! The Gemini corset has a slightly higher back compared to the hourglass corsets, to help hold in the "muffin top" or skin roll-over.

Crafted from cream cotton, the Through the Grapevine corset features a lush botanical print of ripening red grapes and verdant leaves. This striking design is framed by deep forest-green binding and finished with a classic silver busk. To ensure a perfect fit for every body type, this collection is available in three distinct silhouettes: Overbust Slim, Libby, and Cupped Gemini.


The Libby is identical to the Libra in every way except the waist reduction is less dramatic. In the years since the Libra was released, we noticed that there was a real need for a less extreme version. The Libby is a perfect "stepping stone" corset for those who want to waist train and eventually graduate to the original Libra. Ideal for "ruler" or "apple" shaped wearers, or muscular wearers who don't have a lot of squish.

Through clever design, the Libby still looks surprisingly curvy and does not give a "straight" figure. This is why we prefer to call it the Libra Gentle, or just "Libby", instead of the Libra Slim.

  • If you wear the original Libra with a small lacing gap: go up 1 size in the Libby
  • If you wear the original Libra laced closed: go up 2 sizes in the Libby

If you're ever not sure about your size, reach out to us at support@timeless-trends.com !

* Why do we insist on a lacing gap for our overbusts?
A lacing gap makes sure that the "dip" at the side seam will align with your armpit. Imagine the bottom of the armscye where a sleeve is placed in a shirt. You don't want the arm hole to be too forward or too back!
Our hourglass overbusts also have a high back to help smooth any "muffin" and this part should rest over your shoulder blades. If they are too far back they can lead to more rolls, not less! So a gap is recommended. All of our overbust corsets come with a free laced-in modesty panel to protect your back and look great.

The Toffee Satin corset is a spectacular toffee satin with matching satin trim and satin lacing. The rich sheen fabric will flatter and illuminate every skin tone. Easily glam up your favorite outfit with the Toffee Satin Corset!   It comes in Overbust silhouette to support your figure and help enhance your waist. 

This corset is constructed in our most popular hourglass shape as an overbust, available in three cup sizes to fit your body. This silhouette has a higher back for comfort and support with a built in modesty panel. The front bust lacing provides for additional flexibility for fit and exposure to provide you with the comfort and curves you deserve.

Thank you to all the contributors who have worked with us over the years to make this corset possible:

Amber Welch for the initial design. Lowana O'Shea (Vanyanis) for adjusting the pattern for comfort, and Lucy (Lucy's Corsetry) for her input to making this possible, and all our customers who asked for the Hourglass Overbust!

SKU: UFR-694

Fresh, romantic, and effortlessly elegant, our Basil & Lace Corset features delicate ivory floral lace layered over soft basil green satin for a timeless botanical look. Finished with matching green binding and silver hardware, it offers the signature Timeless Trends fit with beautiful shaping and lasting comfort. Perfect for bridal looks, garden parties, cottage core styling, or adding a touch of romance to your everyday wardrobe. 🌿 Available in Overbust Slim and Hourglass Silhouette, Funnel, Regular.

✨ Timeless Trends continues its partnership with Lucy Corsetry! 👗💫

After hearing lots of feedback about the Underbust Hourglass Regular (UHR), Lucy designed the UFR: Underbust, Funnel, Regular. The UFR keeps the same length, rib, and hip spring as our Hourglass Regular, but with a few thoughtful tweaks:

  • Straight (funnel) rib: The biggest difference—gives a tapered, sleek look.
  • Smoother lower tummy: Less pointed at the center front, making it sit better under clothing.
  • Squared upper back: Reduces “muffin top” around the shoulder blades.
  • Adjusted waistline: UFR is 5" from waist to underbust and 5" from waist to lower edge (compared to 5.5" and 4.5" on UHR), so shorter above the waist and slightly longer below.
  • Enhanced waist-to-hip curve: A slightly more convex shape and a bit longer on the hip for added comfort, especially for those with sensitive hip bones.

🖤 Currently available in Black Cotton, Beige Cotton, Black Fine Mesh No Line, and Beige Fine Mesh No Line fabrics.

 


Sizing overview

The White Satin Overbust Corset is great for your any day! We use a 3-point fitting system that conforms to your waist, bust, and hips to ensure a customized fit right for you and your shape. Made of high-quality satin, our white satin corset is perfect for stealthing or any special occasion.

Sizing overview

Now three ways to confirm your size!

  1. Check whether your body type is generally compatible
  2. Take your measurements and follow our size charts
  3. Try the sizing bot (shared with permission from Lucy's Corsetry!)
  4. Still not sure? Reach out to us at support@timeless-trends.com !

 

*The slim overbusts come in 33 different sizes (11 waist sizes and 3 bust sizes) as well as feature adjustable hip lacing, so they fit the widest range of body types of any of our corsets.

 

Waist chart
